title: DataBridge
tagline: A place to store and compute over valuable datasets. DataBridge mission is to create an easy to use platform that can get used by users and companies
description:
DataBridge is an innovative platform that revolutionizes data management for individuals and companies. Here's an improved overview of its key features:

Verifiable Computations and Bounty Requests: Powered by the advanced Bacalhau oracle and a Lilypad-inspired architecture, DataBridge enables users to perform verifiable computations on their data. The Bacalhau oracle handles diverse computations, ensuring integrity. Moreover, the platform facilitates bounty requests, inviting data scientists to propose efficient and valuable computational jobs. Job creators receive small rewards when their jobs are computed by others, promoting collaboration and incentivizing innovation.

Encrypted Data Storage: DataBridge prioritizes data privacy and security. By utilizing the Lighthouse SDK, the platform offers encrypted data storage for IPFS and prepares files for storage deals on Filecoin. Users can confidently store sensitive information, ensuring data confidentiality and integrity.

DataBridge provides a secure and robust storage solution on Filecoin. Users can easily create their dataDAO and request verified storage using the dataDAO factory and dataCap API. The enhanced dealClient contract ensures efficient management of verified storage requests, ensuring data integrity and security. Furthermore, the dataDAO contract integrates seamlessly with Tableland. This integration allows for easy indexing of contract requests and the associated deals made within the platform. 

Data Collaboration and Sharing: With its intuitive interface, DataBridge fosters seamless collaboration and knowledge sharing. Whether working on files or securely sharing data, the platform promotes efficient collaboration, driving innovation and productivity within teams and organizations.

Data Monetization: DataBridge empowers companies to unlock the value of their data assets. By offering their data for use by others, organizations can generate revenue and capitalize on their valuable information. The integrated multi-sig wallet contract and proposal tracking mechanism streamline the data monetization process, ensuring efficient management and facilitating revenue generation.

DataBridge provides a comprehensive solution for secure data storage, verifiable computations with bounty requests, encrypted data storage, data collaboration, and monetization.
how_its_made:
DataBridge was developed with careful attention to detail, using advanced technologies and implementing innovative enhancements. Here are the key aspects of its development:

Enhanced dealClient Contract and DataDAO Factory: We improved the dealClient contract and transformed it into a sophisticated dataDAO. This upgrade aligns with the evolving standards set by the Filecoin team. We integrated the dataCap API and Tableland decentralized database, which improved storage request management and made contract information more accessible. These changes take the dealClient contract to a higher level of data management.

Robust Bacalhau Oracle and Scalable Server: We designed a strong Bacalhau oracle contract supported by a scalable server infrastructure. This combination allows users to perform accurate and reliable verifiable computations on their data. The Bacalhau oracle ensures a seamless and trustworthy computation experience within the DataBridge platform.

Leveraging the Lighthouse SDK: DataBridge prioritizes data security by using the Lighthouse SDK. This integration enables encrypted data storage for IPFS and simplifies file preparation for secure storage deals on the Filecoin network. By implementing rigorous encryption practices, DataBridge ensures the confidentiality and integrity of user data.

Multisig Factory and Tableland Integration: To facilitate collaborative decision-making and trust verification, we developed a multisig factory within DataBridge. By leveraging Tableland, a decentralized database, we efficiently store multisig proposals and transactions in a cost-effective manner. Multisigs allow groups to securely validate and monetize valuable actions.

Data Monetization and NFT Transformation: DataBridge supports data monetization through its backend system. Additionally, we offer a unique contract that enables the transformation of datasets into non-fungible tokens (NFTs). Access to decrypted data is restricted to NFT holders, providing a secure approach to data monetization.
